paper_metadata.title: Effect of Oxide Species and Thermomechanical Treatments on the Strength Properties of Mechanically Alloyed Fe-17%Cr Ferritic ODS Materials

evidence.quote: The effects of several oxide species, such as Y:O3, ZrO: and MgO, and the thermomechanical treatment (TMT) after the mechanical alloying (MA) process on the strength properties of Fe-17%Cr ferritic ODS (oxide dispersion strengthening) MA materials were investigated.
